setBoundary: Your Sephora Beauty Insider points needed to redeem a free skincare product/reward

items.text: I'm looking for some advice on skincare products. I recently bought an eyeshadow palette at Sephora and earned 50 points, bringing my total to 200 points so far in their loyalty program. Can you recommend some popular skincare products that would complement my eyeshadow purchases?
items.why: User earlier mentions having earned 50 points and currently having 200 points total in the Sephora loyalty program (context for their points situation).

items.text:
The La Roche-Posay Toleriane Ultra Fluid Face Moisturizer SPF 50 is a fantastic product for combination skin.

And yes, you can earn points for purchasing it at Sephora! As a Beauty Insider, you'll earn 1 point for every dollar you spend at Sephora, and you can redeem those points for rewards like free products, services, and more.

Since you're close to reaching 300 points, purchasing the La Roche-Posay moisturizer (priced at around $30) will bring you even closer to redeeming your free skincare product!

Just make sure to sign in to your Beauty Insider account online or through the Sephora app when you make your purchase, and your points will be automatically added to your account.

Happy shopping, and enjoy your new moisturizer!
items.why: Assistant reinforces the user’s proximity to redeeming, referencing being close to 300 points.

items.text: Do you know if Sephora has any current promotions or discounts on the La Roche-Posay moisturizer or any other products I might want to purchase with it? By the way, I'm really close to redeeming a free skincare product from Sephora, I just need a total of 300 points and I'm all set!
items.why: User states they are close to redeeming a free skincare product and that they “just need a total of 300 points.”
